d: Deep purple hair is styled in a side ponytail with long, sweeping bangs and a stray ahoge strand. Golden-amber eyes have a wide, surprised expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender, dressed in a white long-sleeved collared shirt under a maroon pinafore dress with yellow straps and a large teal bow at the neck. A white ribbon with red edges ties the ponytail, and a black strap is visible on the thigh.
